ts_collagen_renew.name: Collagen Renew
ts_collagen_renew.key: 17.5 g collagen peptides: TENDOFORTE, FORTIGEL and FORTIBONE 5 g each, VERISOL 2.5 g
ts_collagen_renew.dosesub:
about 1 hour before exercise,
any time on rest days
ts_collagen_renew.src: Supplement Facts from NutriDyn sell sheet 'Collagen Renew SS ND569' (Rev. 9/24, Dropbox Practitioner Resource/Marketing Materials) as recorded in scratchpad labels/labels.json R190: about 1 scoop (17.5 g), about 30 servings, collagen peptides 17.5 g = FORTIGEL 5 g + FORTIBONE 5 g + TENDOFORTE 5 g + VERISOL 2.5 g, protein 15 g; directions 'Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water, your favorite beverage, or a recipe'. Corroborated by products DB R190 (catalog ND143 10/1/26 via five switch charts) and the repo blast blasts/2026-10-19-collagen-tendon.html (panel read live; no vitamin C in the formula). Size R190 525G from price list ND144 10/1/26. Product URL from the same blast (curl-verified 2026-08-11). Bottle photo R190 (unflavored, 18.52 oz / 525 g, 30 servings). The sheet's dose line '1 scoop in 8 oz water' is the label direction; 'about 1 hour before exercise, any time on rest days' is the sheet's timing from Shaw 2017 (PMID 27852613), not a label direction.

ts_inflam_eze_plus.name: Inflam-Eze Plus
ts_inflam_eze_plus.key: Per 3 capsules: ginger 800 mg, CurQfen curcumin-fenugreek 250 mg, boswellia 250 mg, white willow 200 mg, hops 150 mg, devil’s claw 60 mg
ts_inflam_eze_plus.src: Supplement Facts from NutriDyn sell sheet 'Inflam-Eze Plus SS ND516' (Rev. 5/25) as recorded in scratchpad labels/labels.json R856 / R856L: serving 3 capsules; ginger root powder 800 mg; CurQfen = proprietary mix of curcumin extract (35% curcuminoids) and fenugreek galactomannans extract, 250 mg for the mix (so the key says 'curcumin-fenugreek 250 mg', not 250 mg of curcumin); Boswellia serrata gum extract 250 mg (65% boswellic acid); white willow bark extract 200 mg (25% salicin); hops extract 150 mg (2% xanthohumol); devil's claw root extract 60 mg (1.2% harpagosides); directions 'Take 3 capsules once daily with food'; caution 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use' (carried into the sheet's check panel). Matches products DB R856 (catalog ND143 10/1/26). Sizes R856 90C and R856L 180C from price list ND144 10/1/26. URL slug from build/products.py SLUGS ('inflam-eze-plus', NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc).

ts_omega_1000.name: Omega Pure EPA‑DHA 1000
ts_omega_1000.key: 1,000 mg EPA + DHA per softgel (730 mg EPA, 270 mg DHA)
ts_omega_1000.src: products DB R243 (scratchpad products/nutridyn_products.json, Pure Encapsulations chart label check of NutriDyn catalog ND143 10/1/26): 'EPA+DHA per softgel (1 softgel per serving each): NutriDyn 1,000 mg (EPA 730 mg + DHA 270 mg)'; directions 'Take one softgel up to three times daily with food'; size R243 120S. Same facts as the shared products.py entry omega_1000; this sheet-own entry exists so the name breaks as 'Omega Pure / EPA-DHA 1000': a no-break hyphen (U+2011), which kit.print_safe prints as a plain hyphen inside an unbreakable span (the word joiner used before is now stripped by print_safe, which let the name split after 'EPA-'), and a no-break space before 1000; alt text gets a plain hyphen. Dose follows the label: one softgel at a time, twice daily with meals (2 a day, within the label's up to 3). Photo img-src/R243.png, 848x1552 (text-safe 4x AI upscale of the 244x420 web render, img-src/SOURCES.md). URL slug from build/products.py SLUGS (omega-pure-epa-dha-1000). Allergen and shell, for the sheet's fish-allergy check: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000 SS ND416' (Rev. 4/25), as recorded in products.d/neuropathy.json nrp_omega: Other Ingredients 'Highly concentrated omega-3 fish oil (anchovy, sardine, mackerel), capsule shell (gelatin, glycerin, purified water)...', allergen line 'Contains: Fish (Anchovy, Sardine, and Mackerel).', caution 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' The gelatin's animal source is not printed.

ts_d3_5000_k2.name: D3 5000 with K2
ts_d3_5000_k2.key: 5,000 IU (125 mcg) vitamin D3, 60 mcg vitamin K2 (MK-7), 15 mcg vitamin K1
ts_d3_5000_k2.src: products DB R197 (Designs for Health chart label checks of catalog ND143 10/1/26): per serving vitamin D3 125 mcg (5,000 IU), vitamin K1 15 mcg, vitamin K2 60 mcg as MK-7; directions 'Take one softgel daily'; size 60S. The bottle photo (img-src/R197.png) reads '60 SOFTGELS' and 'Featuring MenaQ7 Vitamin K2'. The shared products.py entry d3_5000_k2 now says softgels too; this sheet keeps its own entry for its fuller In each serving line (IU and mcg) and its evening-meal timing, and leaves the shared one alone. URL slug from build/products.py SLUGS (d3-5000-with-k2).
